subject: Tufts Boston Avenue Redesign
overview: The Medford Bicycling Advisory Commission met to discuss membership recruitment, outreach strategies, and winter snow removal planning. The commission spent substantial time reviewing design concepts for the Tufts Boston Avenue redesign, agreeing to advocate for safe bicycle infrastructure over street parking.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from its September meeting.

items.title: Meeting Schedule Adjustments
items.summary: The commission voted to cancel its regular November and December meetings and hold a single combined meeting on December 9, 2026.

items.title: Commission Membership and Media Working Group
items.summary: Members discussed outreach strategies to fill commission vacancies and voted to create a working group to explore newsletters and media engagement.

items.title: Event Recaps and Outreach Materials
items.summary: The commission reviewed feedback from Tufts Community Day, Harvest Your Energy, and a Walk Medford meeting, agreeing to develop improved educational materials for future tabling events.

items.title: Greenway and Bridge Project Updates
items.summary: Members received updates on the Wellington Greenway Phase 4 project and noted that construction has begun on the Fellsway underpass bridge.

items.title: Tufts Boston Avenue Redesign Concepts
items.summary: Emily O'Brien presented design options for Boston Avenue between Winthrop Street and College Avenue, and the commission agreed to advocate for street layouts that prioritize safe bike lanes over preserving parking spaces.

items.title: Winter Snow Removal Planning
items.summary: The commission voted to table remaining agenda items and agreed to submit a list of winter clearing priority bike corridors to city administration.
